description.sub_name: 國際永續發展法制專題研究
description.sub_ename: SEMINAR ON INTERNATIONAL SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT AND LAW
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在因應全球永續發展趨勢與法制變革，探討永續理念如何融入國際法律制度與政策架構。內容涵蓋聯合國永續發展目標（SDGs）、企業社會責任、環境法規、永續金融與租稅策略等議題，並透過跨領域整合，強化學生對永續政策與法制實務的理解與應用能力。課程鼓勵參與討論與研究，培養學生具備面對全球永續挑戰所需的法學素養與國際視野。
description.describe_eh: This course responds to global trends in sustainable development and legal transformation. It explores how sustainability principles are integrated into international legal systems and policy frameworks. Topics include the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), corporate social responsibility, environmental regulations, sustainable finance, and tax strategies. Through interdisciplinary integration, the course enhances students’ understanding and application of sustainability-related legal and policy issues. Students are encouraged to engage in discussions and research to develop the legal literacy and global perspective needed to address future challenges in sustainability.

targets.describe_ch: 學生能描述全球永續發展與國際法制演變趨勢，並辨識不同永續議題在法律制度中的重點與挑戰。
targets.describe_en: Students will be able to describe global trends in sustainable development and legal evolution, and identify key issues within various legal systems.

targets.describe_ch: 學生能掌握永續發展相關法制架構之基本內容，並辨識在不同國際環境下的法律應用重點。
targets.describe_en: Students will understand the fundamental structures of sustainability-related legal frameworks and recognize critical applications in different international contexts.

targets.describe_ch: 學生能說明永續金融、環境稅制及相關法令規範，並分析其對企業與政策制定的影響及應對策略。
targets.describe_en: Students will explain the basics of sustainable finance, environmental taxation, and relevant legal regulations, and analyze their impact on policy and corporate strategies.

targets.describe_ch: 學生能探討國際永續政策與法制實務的互動關係，並透過個案分析反思制度設計與執行的成效與改進方向。
targets.describe_en: Students will explore the interaction between international sustainability policies and legal practices, analyze case studies, and reflect on the effectiveness and potential improvements of legal and institutional designs.
